<document name="How Fernwood runs.docx" pages="4">
[Page 3]
Money: tools, budgets and spend
Lena Ortiz owns our tools list: every software seat and vendor, what it costs a year and when it renews. Each team has a budget for the quarter, and Lena tracks what is spent against it. Tool owners are reminded a month before a tool renews.
Expenses and purchases go through Spend. People submit their own expenses with a receipt and a category; Lena approves them and marks them paid. Purchases over $2,000 need Krishna's approval. Each person sees their own spend; Lena and Wade see all of it.
Time off: people request it, their manager approves or declines, and it is marked taken once the days have passed. Lena keeps everyone's yearly balance.

</document>

<document name="Fernwood policies.pdf" pages="38">
[Page 4]
Expense policy
Every expense needs a receipt and a category before it can be approved. The categories are
Software, Travel, Cloud, Meals, Office, Equipment, Training and Other.
Lena Ortiz approves or rejects every submitted expense. Nobody approves their own
expense.
Team meals are paid up to $40 a person. Expenses are paid with the next payroll once
approved.

[Page 8]
Expense policy (continued)
Receipts are kept with the expense. An expense without a receipt waits on the person who
submitted it until the receipt is attached.

[Page 9]
Purchasing policy
Purchases are requested in Spend and approved before they are ordered. Purchases over
$2,000 need Krishna's approval; Lena approves the rest.
A purchase moves from requested to approved, ordered and received.

[Page 11]
Budgets
Each team has a budget per quarter. Spending counts against the budget of the person's
team.

</document>
